summary: This clinical trial is testing a study drug called elecoglipron compared to a placebo in adults who have type 2 diabetes and kidney problems. Type 2 diabetes is a condition where the body does not use insulin properly to control blood sugar. A placebo is an inactive substance that looks like the study drug but has no medicine in it. The sponsor, AstraZeneca, plans to enroll 900 participants in this Phase 3 study, which is currently Recruiting.
